title: Qualify live Token telemetry and establish the first real baseline
scope: Qualify Codex usage sources, stop terminal-task resume attempts, and add a read-only preflight that distinguishes exact active-thread usage from account-wide unallocated usage without inventing Work Item attribution.
acceptance_criteria: Completed or cancelled registered tasks are reconciled from history but are never resumed as live subscriptions or used to degrade the Provider.
A read-only usage preflight reports detailed-thread readiness, observed usage coverage, task topology, and an explicitly requested Codex account-usage capability probe.
Account-wide usage is labeled unallocated and cannot be assigned to a project, Work Item, Position, task, model, cost, or outcome.
Missing live usage remains unknown, automatic routing stays disabled, and no prompt, hidden reasoning, credential, raw account value, or external mutation is retained.
Tests reproduce a real terminal-task topology, active-task readiness, account-probe success and failure, parser compatibility, and fail-closed attribution behavior.
Documentation records the official protocol basis, measurement overhead, limitations, and the remaining multi-Work-Item longitudinal baseline.

required_human_approval: The project owner explicitly authorized the recommended WI-0011 implementation, verification, and local closeout path. This approval closes only the bounded local organizational scope and grants no push, publication, deployment, spending, external notification, tracker write, model switch, or production release authority.
